semiconductor_relevance: Medium — AKTANTIS facilitates collaboration among various players in the semiconductor ecosystem, contributing to innovation and growth.
summary: AKTANTIS is a cluster based in southern France that focuses on advancing technologies in the semiconductor value chain, particularly in electronics/microelectronics, IoT, AI/data analytics, and cybersecurity. It brings together nearly 300 industrial players, including multinationals, SMEs, startups, research labs, and universities, to foster collaboration and innovation.
capabilities: Facilitating collaboration among semiconductor ecosystem players
Supporting development in IoT and AI/data analytics
Enhancing cybersecurity solutions within the semiconductor industry

regional_presence.Europe: Based in southern France, AKTANTIS coordinates a network of nearly 300 industrial players across the region.
